executive_summary.title: Copernicus CAMS Surface Ozone Machine Learning Enhancement
executive_summary.description: High-resolution geospatial post-processing of Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) global atmospheric forecasts using Gradient Boosted Decision Trees and static physiographic terrain covariates.

benchmark_cv.description: 5-Fold Spatial Group Cross-Validation (GroupKFold across 20 stations, 4 full stations held out per fold)

benchmark_holdout.description: Spatial Holdout Test Set: Stations 17 (Inland Delhi-NCR) & 5624 (Near-Coast Hyderabad)

feature_importance.title: Mean Elevation (20km radius)
feature_importance.description: Governs regional planetary boundary layer height and baseline free-tropospheric ozone intrusion.

feature_importance.title: Day of Year (Sinusoidal)
feature_importance.description: Captures the broad 3-month seasonal solar radiation and monsoon shift governing photochemical ozone synthesis.

feature_importance.title: Topographic Roughness (Std Dev)
feature_importance.description: Represents local topographic slope gradients that steer valley drainage, surface ventilation, and stagnant pollutant pooling.

feature_importance.title: Distance to Coastline
feature_importance.description: Delineates marine boundary layer conditions (elevated moisture, sea breeze) from dry continental inland air masses.

feature_importance.title: Day of Year (Cosine)
feature_importance.description: Complements annual progression to track post-monsoon photochemical transition phases and cloud wash-out dynamics.

feature_importance.title: Surface Air Pressure
feature_importance.description: Reflects synoptic anti-cyclonic subsidence and boundary layer compression favoring smog accumulation.

feature_importance.title: Astronomical Day Length
feature_importance.description: Total daily solar insolation window available for photochemical formation.

feature_importance.title: 10m Wind Direction
feature_importance.description: Identifies synoptic and meso-scale upwind transport corridors carrying precursor NOx and VOCs.

feature_importance.title: 10m Wind Speed
feature_importance.description: Controls horizontal mechanical dispersion and ventilation of boundary-layer precursors.

feature_importance.title: 2m Dewpoint Temperature
feature_importance.description: Atmospheric moisture proxy; modulates radical chemical termination and localized cloud attenuation.

feature_importance.title: Upwind Station Lagged Ozone
feature_importance.description: Transports empirical upstream ozone observations downwind with physical travel delays, providing advective memory.

feature_importance.title: 2m Air Temperature
feature_importance.description: Direct kinetic driver of hydrocarbon oxidation and photochemical ozone generation.

feature_importance.title: CAMS NO₂ Mixing Ratio
feature_importance.description: Key combustion precursor governing ozone photostationary state and titration.

feature_importance.title: CAMS Isoprene Mixing Ratio
feature_importance.description: Biogenic precursor VOC driving photochemical ozone generation in vegetated regions.

feature_importance.title: CAMS Raw Ozone Forecast
feature_importance.description: Global deterministic CAMS chemical transport model baseline prior to ML correction.

feature_importance.title: Hour of Day (Cosine)
feature_importance.description: Tracks nocturnal boundary layer collapse and nocturnal titration by NO.

feature_importance.title: Hour of Day (Sinusoidal)
feature_importance.description: Diurnal solar elevation tracking peak afternoon photochemical ozone synthesis.
